## Button

Svelte: `import { Button } from '@mozra-the-great/kern'` · Element: `<k-button>` aus `@mozra-the-great/kern/elements/button`

Quelle: [`Button.svelte`](../../src/lib/components/Button.svelte), [`KButton.svelte`](../../src/elements/KButton.svelte)

Button, or a link with `href` (also `target`, `rel`, `download`). A disabled or loading link stays a link without href and with `aria-disabled="true"`. `size="icon"` is a square for an icon: give it a `label`. While `loading`, a polite status text is announced (`loading-label`, default "Loading").

### Svelte: Props

| Prop | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `variant` | `'primary' \| 'secondary' \| 'ghost' \| 'accent' \| 'danger'` | `'primary'` | Visual weight. One `primary` per view. |
| `size` | `'sm' \| 'md' \| 'lg' \| 'icon'` | `'md'` | Height from the theme: `sm` = `--k-control-h-sm`, `md` = `--k-control-h`, `lg` = `--k-control-h-lg` (never below `--k-tap-target`). `icon` is a `--k-tap-icon` square for an icon without text: give it an `aria-label`. |
| `block` | `boolean` | `false` | Full width. |
| `wide` | `boolean` | `false` | Full width with the label at the start and the last child (arrow, icon, count) at the end. |
| `loading` | `boolean` |  | Shows a spinner and blocks clicks. The state is also said, not only shown: a polite status text (`loadingLabel`) is announced when it starts, so it does not depend on the motion of the spinner. |
| `loadingLabel` | `string` | Katalog `button.loadingLabel` | Status text announced (polite) while `loading`, e.g. "Loading". It is not part of the button's name, which stays its visible label. Default: the catalogue text (`strings().button.loadingLabel`). |
| `href` | `string` |  | Renders an `<a>` instead of a `<button>` (attributes that only buttons know are passed on as they are). With `disabled` or `loading` it stays an `<a>`, without `href` and with `aria-disabled="true"`: it cannot be followed and leaves the tab order. |
| `target` | `HTMLAnchorAttributes['target']` |  | Link only: browsing context, as on `<a>`. |
| `rel` | `string \| null` |  | Link only: relation, as on `<a>`. |
| `download` | `string \| boolean \| null` |  | Link only: download the target instead of navigating; a string is the file name. |
| `hreflang` | `string \| null` |  | Link only: language of the linked page. |
| `referrerpolicy` | `ReferrerPolicy \| null` |  | Link only: referrer policy, as on `<a>`. |
| `type` | geerbt | `'button'` |  |
| `class` | geerbt | `''` |  |

Weitere Attribute aus `HTMLButtonAttributes` gehen an das Wurzelelement.

| `children` | `Snippet` |  |

## Card

Svelte: `import { Card } from '@mozra-the-great/kern'` · Element: `<k-card>` aus `@mozra-the-great/kern/elements/card`

Quelle: [`Card.svelte`](../../src/lib/components/Card.svelte), [`KCard.svelte`](../../src/elements/KCard.svelte)

Card. `clickable` turns the title into a button that covers the card and fires `action`; controls in the `footer` and `badges` slots and in the content stay separate and clickable. `as="li"` gives the element the role `listitem`, for cards directly inside a `<ul>`.

### Svelte: Props

| Prop | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `string` |  | Heading text. Without it the card has no heading (no empty `<hN>`). |
| `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `level` | `2 \| 3 \| 4` | `3` | Heading level of the title. |
| `look` | `'raised' \| 'sunken' \| 'outline'` | `'raised'` | `raised` = on bg-raised, `sunken` = recessed, `outline` = border only. |
| `as` | `'article' \| 'section' \| 'div' \| 'li'` | `'article'` | Root element. `article` (default) for a self-contained item, `section` for a part of the page, `div` for plain grouping, `li` for a card that is an item of a `<ul>`/`<ol>`. |
| `href` | `string` |  | Makes the whole card a link: the title becomes a link whose hit area covers the card. |
| `actionLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the card's link or button. Default: the title (then `description`). Keep the visible title in it, e.g. "Edit Ruby Red" for the title "Ruby Red". |
| `actionHaspopup` | `HTMLButtonAttributes['aria-haspopup']` |  | `aria-haspopup` of the card's button, e.g. `dialog` when it opens one. |
| `muted` | `boolean` | `false` | Dimmed look for an item that is used up, gone or archived. Only visual: say it in the content too. |
| `class` | `string` | `''` |  |

Weitere Attribute aus `Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>, 'title' \| 'class' \| 'children' \| 'onclick'>` gehen an das Wurzelelement.

### Svelte: Callbacks

| Prop | Typ | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onclick` | `(event: MouseEvent) => void` | Makes the whole card open something: the title becomes a `<button>` whose hit area covers the card (Enter and Space work). Without `href` only; other actions in `footer`, `badges` and the content stay separate controls above it, never inside it. |

### Svelte: Snippets

| Snippet | Typ | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `media` | `Snippet` | Content above the title, e.g. an image or motif. |
| `badges` | `Snippet` | Small markers in the top corner (count, state); controls in it stay clickable. |
| `footer` | `Snippet` | Row of actions at the bottom. |
| `children` | `Snippet` |  |

### Element: Attribute und Properties

| Attribut | Property | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `title` | `string` |  | Heading text. Without it the card has no heading (no empty `<hN>`). |
| `description` | `description` | `string` |  |  |
| `level` | `level` | `number` | `3` (wie Card) | Heading level of the title. |
| `look` | `look` | `string` | `'raised'` (wie Card) | `raised` = on bg-raised, `sunken` = recessed, `outline` = border only. |
| `as` | `as` | `'article' \| 'section' \| 'div' \| 'li'` | `'article'` (wie Card) | Root element; `li` sets `role="listitem"` on the element itself. |
| `href` | `href` | `string` |  | Makes the whole card a link: the title becomes a link whose hit area covers the card. |
| `clickable` | `clickable` | `boolean` | `false` | The card opens something: fires `action` on click, Enter or Space. |
| `action-label` | `actionLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the card's link or button. Default: the title (then `description`). Keep the visible title in it, e.g. "Edit Ruby Red" for the title "Ruby Red". |
| `action-haspopup` | `actionHaspopup` | `string` |  | `aria-haspopup` of the card's button, e.g. `dialog` when it opens one. |
| `muted` | `muted` | `boolean` | `false` | Dimmed look for an item that is used up, gone or archived. Only visual: say it in the content too. |

| `cycles` | `number` | `4` | Blink cycles before the caret stays solid (WCAG 2.2.2: blinking over 5 s needs a way to stop). 0 = blink forever. |

## DownloadButton

Svelte: `import { DownloadButton } from '@mozra-the-great/kern'` · Element: `<k-download-button>` aus `@mozra-the-great/kern/elements/download-button`

Quelle: [`DownloadButton.svelte`](../../src/lib/components/DownloadButton.svelte), [`KDownloadButton.svelte`](../../src/elements/KDownloadButton.svelte)

Saves text or bytes as a file download and announces the result in a polite live region, once per click; the message stays until the next click. The content is the `text` attribute, or the JS property `blob` (a `Blob` or `File`) or `getContent` (a function that returns a string or a Blob, also as a promise, called at click time); `getContent` wins over `blob`, `blob` over `text`. `name` is the file name (cleaned), `type` the MIME type. `show-label` shows `label` as visible text; an error is always shown as text under the button. Nothing is sent anywhere.

### Svelte: Props

| Prop | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string` |  | Text to save (UTF-8). Used when neither `getContent` nor `blob` is set. |
| `blob` | `Blob` |  | Bytes to save. Wins over `text`. A `File` works too. |
| `getContent` | `(() => DownloadContent \| Promise<DownloadContent>)` |  | Makes the content at click time: a string or a `Blob`, directly or as a promise. Wins over `blob` and `text`. While a promise is pending the button shows a spinner and ignores clicks. A function that throws or rejects, or returns something else, shows `errorLabel` and calls `onerror` with code `content`. |
| `name` | `string` |  | File name, e.g. `report.csv`. Cleaned before use (no path, control or direction characters). Default: the catalogue's `fallbackName`. |
| `type` | `string` |  | MIME type. For text it defaults to `text/plain` (`;charset=utf-8` is added). For a `Blob` it replaces the blob's own type when set. |
| `label` | `string` | Katalog `downloadButton.label` | Accessible name, e.g. "Download report". Icon-only by default (it is the `aria-label` and the tooltip); with `showLabel` it is visible text and the name comes from it. |
| `showLabel` | `boolean` | `false` | Show `label` as text next to the icon instead of an icon-only button. |

## FileDrop

Svelte: `import { FileDrop } from '@mozra-the-great/kern'` · Element: `<k-file-drop>` aus `@mozra-the-great/kern/elements/file-drop`

Quelle: [`FileDrop.svelte`](../../src/lib/components/FileDrop.svelte), [`KFileDrop.svelte`](../../src/elements/KFileDrop.svelte)

Drop zone and file picker. The chosen files are the property `el.files`; setting it (e.g. to `[]` after an upload) replaces them without an event, `el.reset()` also clears the messages. `required` needs at least one file. `mode="dispatch"` keeps no list: every pick or drop fires `files` with just those files. Only name, type and size of a file are read, never its content.

### Svelte: Props

| Prop | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `string` |  |  |
| `error` | `string` |  | Error text from outside, e.g. a failed upload. Rejected files add their own message. |
| `accept` | `string` |  | Same syntax as `<input accept>`: `.pdf`, `image/*`, `image/png`. Also enforced for dropped files. |
| `multiple` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `maxSize` | `number` |  | Largest allowed file in bytes. |
| `mode` | `'field' \| 'dispatch'` | `'field'` | `field` (default): a form field that keeps the chosen files in a list (remove buttons, `files`, form value) and adds new ones to it. `dispatch`: hands every pick or drop to `onfiles` and forgets it (no list, `files` stays empty, no form value, the same file can be picked again), for tools that process files at once. |
| `files` (`bind:`) | `File[]` |  | The chosen files (`field` mode). |
| `rejectMessages` | `boolean` | `true` | Show and announce a message for refused files (`typeError`, `sizeError`, `countError`). Turn off when the host reports them itself from `onreject`. |
| `name` | `string` |  | Form field name; the files are submitted with the form (`field` mode). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `required` | `boolean` | `false` |  |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `dropLabel` | `string` |  | Text in the drop zone. |
| `buttonLabel` | `string` |  | Label of a separate button that opens the file picker. Without it the whole zone is the button; with it the zone is a group (named by `label` and the drop text) that holds this button. |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | Katalog `fileDrop.removeLabel` | Prefix of the remove buttons' accessible names: "Remove report.pdf". |
| `listLabel` | `string` | Katalog `fileDrop.listLabel` | Accessible name of the list of chosen files. |
| `sizeError` | `string` | Katalog `fileDrop.sizeError` | Message for a file that is too large. `{name}` and `{max}` are replaced. |
| `typeError` | `string` | Katalog `fileDrop.typeError` | Message for a file of a type that is not accepted. `{name}` is replaced. |
| `countError` | `string` | Katalog `fileDrop.countError` | Message when several files were offered but only one is allowed. |
| `statusLabel` | `string` | Katalog `fileDrop.statusLabel` | Announced after a change. `{count}` is replaced. |
| `class` | `string` | `''` |  |

### Svelte: Callbacks

| Prop | Typ | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onfiles` | `(files: File[]) => void` | `field`: the full list of chosen files after every change. `dispatch`: the files of this pick or drop. |
| `onreject` | `(files: File[]) => void` | Called with the refused files of a pick or drop: type not in `accept`, larger than `maxSize`, or more than one without `multiple` (all but the first). |

| Attribut | Property | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `label` | `label` | `string` |  |  |
| `hint` | `hint` | `string` |  |  |

## OnlineStatus

Svelte: `import { OnlineStatus } from '@mozra-the-great/kern'` · Element: `<k-online-status>` aus `@mozra-the-great/kern/elements/online-status`

Quelle: [`OnlineStatus.svelte`](../../src/lib/components/OnlineStatus.svelte), [`KOnlineStatus.svelte`](../../src/elements/KOnlineStatus.svelte)

Shows a non-blocking notice while the browser is offline (`navigator.onLine`, the `online` and `offline` events) and says the changes through the page's `<k-live-announcer>`. Without one on the page the notice is its own live region. Nothing is shown while online.

### Svelte: Props

| Prop | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `online` (`bind:`) | `boolean` |  | Whether the browser reports a connection. Read it with `bind:online`; it is set after mount and follows the `online` and `offline` events. `navigator.onLine` is a hint, not a guarantee: it says whether there is a network, not whether the server answers. |
| `offlineTitle` | `string` | Katalog `onlineStatus.offlineTitle` | Heading of the notice, also announced when the connection is lost. Default: "You are offline". |
| `offlineText` | `string` | Katalog `onlineStatus.offlineText` | Second line of the notice. `''` leaves it out. Default: see the strings catalogue. |
| `onlineText` | `string` | Katalog `onlineStatus.onlineText` | Announced when the connection returns. `''` announces nothing. Default: "Back online". |
| `announce` | `boolean` | `true` | Say the changes through the live-region announcer (`announce()`). Without a mounted one the notice speaks for itself. Default true. |
| `politeness` | `Politeness` | `'polite'` | How urgent the offline announcement is. Default `polite`. |
| `announcer` | `Announcer` |  | Announcer to use. Default: the page-wide one behind `announce()`. |
| `class` | `string` | `''` |  |

### Svelte: Callbacks

| Prop | Typ | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onchange` | `(online: boolean) => void` | The connection was lost or came back (not at mount). |

| Attribut | Property | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `offline-title` | `offlineTitle` | `string` | Katalog `onlineStatus.offlineTitle` (wie OnlineStatus) | Heading of the notice, also announced when the connection is lost. Default: "You are offline". |
| `offline-text` | `offlineText` | `string` | Katalog `onlineStatus.offlineText` (wie OnlineStatus) | Second line of the notice. `''` leaves it out. Default: see the strings catalogue. |
| `online-text` | `onlineText` | `string` | Katalog `onlineStatus.onlineText` (wie OnlineStatus) | Announced when the connection returns. `''` announces nothing. Default: "Back online". |
| `announce` | `announce` | `boolean \| 'false'` | `true` (wie OnlineStatus) | Say the changes through the announcer (default on). |
| `politeness` | `politeness` | `'polite' \| 'assertive'` | `'polite'` (wie OnlineStatus) | How urgent the offline announcement is (default `polite`). |

## Prose

Svelte: `import { Prose } from '@mozra-the-great/kern'` · Element: `<k-prose>` aus `@mozra-the-great/kern/elements/prose`

Quelle: [`Prose.svelte`](../../src/lib/components/Prose.svelte), [`KProse.svelte`](../../src/elements/KProse.svelte)

Typography for long running text, e.g. legal pages. Set `text` (plain text: blank lines make paragraphs, web and e-mail addresses become links, nothing is read as HTML) or place your own markup inside. Line length, leading and spacing come from `--k-prose-*` tokens. A shadow root can style only the elements placed directly inside (headings, paragraphs, lists, links); nested markup keeps the page's own styles.

### Svelte: Props

| Prop | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `string \| null` |  | Plain text: blank lines separate paragraphs, line breaks stay, and web and e-mail addresses become links (external ones open in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`). The text is never read as HTML. Without `text`, the children are set in the same typography. |
| `externalLabel` | `string` |  | Read after external links in `text`. Default: "(opens in a new tab)" (see the strings catalogue). |
| `class` | `string` | `''` |  |

### Svelte: Snippets

| Snippet | Typ | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `children` | `Snippet` | Your own markup (headings, paragraphs, lists, links), used when `text` is not set. |

| Attribut | Property | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | `text` | `string` |  | Plain text: blank lines separate paragraphs, line breaks stay, and web and e-mail addresses become links (external ones open in a new tab with `rel="noopener noreferrer"`). The text is never read as HTML. Without `text`, the children are set in the same typography. |
| `external-label` | `externalLabel` | `string` |  | Read after external links in `text`. Default: "(opens in a new tab)" (see the strings catalogue). |

## SelectGrid

Svelte: `import { SelectGrid } from '@mozra-the-great/kern'` · Element: `<k-select-grid>` aus `@mozra-the-great/kern/elements/select-grid`

Quelle: [`SelectGrid.svelte`](../../src/lib/components/SelectGrid.svelte), [`KSelectGrid.svelte`](../../src/elements/KSelectGrid.svelte)

Grid of pictures as a multi-select listbox (one Tab stop, arrow keys by one place and one row, Home/End/PageUp/PageDown, Space/Enter toggle, Shift extends, Ctrl/Cmd+A all, Esc clears). With `reorderable`, Alt+arrow keys and dragging move the focused item; the element does not reorder `items` itself: set `items` again in the `move` handler (`splice` the item from `from` to `to`; Svelte: `moveItem`). An item shows `src` as a picture and its `label` and `description` as a caption (other pictures, e.g. a canvas: the Svelte component's `item` snippet).

### Svelte: Props

Generisch über `T`.

| Prop | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (Pflicht) | `readonly T[]` |  | The items in their current order. With `reorderable` the grid does not reorder them itself: `onmove` tells you what the user asked for. |
| `key` | `((item: T, index: number) => ItemKey)` |  | Identifies an item while it moves. Default: `item.id`, else the index. |
| `itemLabel` | `((item: T, index: number) => string)` |  | Accessible name of an option. Default: `item.label`, or the item itself when it is a string or number. |
| `selected` (`bind:`) | `readonly ItemKey[]` |  | Keys of the selected items, in the order of `items`. Bindable. |
| `label` | `string` | Katalog `selectGrid.label` | Accessible name of the grid. |
| `min` | `string` |  | Smallest column width (CSS length). Default `150px`. |
| `reorderable` | `boolean` | `false` | Alt + arrow keys and dragging move the focused item (`onmove`). Default false. |
| `caption` | `boolean` |  | Show the caption (label and description) under the picture. Default: true without an `item` snippet, false with one. |
| `reorderHint` | `string` | Katalog `selectGrid.reorderHint` | Text of the hint that tells how to reorder with the keyboard (default: the catalogue). |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `class` | `string` | `''` |  |

### Svelte: Callbacks

| Prop | Typ | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `onchange` | `(selected: ItemKey[]) => void` | The user changed the selection (keyboard, click, select all, clear); never for a `selected` set from code. |
| `onmove` | `(from: number, to: number) => void` | The user moved the item at `from` so that it should end up at `to`. Use `moveItem(items, from, to)`. |

### Svelte: Snippets

| Snippet | Typ | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `item` | `Snippet<[item: T, index: number, selected: boolean]>` | Content of one item (a picture). Default: `item.src` as a picture, `item.label` as a caption. |

| Attribut | Property | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |

| `label` | `label` | `string` | Katalog `selectGrid.label` (wie SelectGrid) | Accessible name of the grid. |

## SortableList

Svelte: `import { SortableList } from '@mozra-the-great/kern'` · Element: `<k-sortable-list>` aus `@mozra-the-great/kern/elements/sortable-list`

Quelle: [`SortableList.svelte`](../../src/lib/components/SortableList.svelte), [`KSortableList.svelte`](../../src/elements/KSortableList.svelte)

Ordered list whose items move with Up, Down and Remove buttons (drag and drop is an extra). The element does not reorder `items` itself: set `items` again in the `move` and `remove` handlers (`splice` the item from `from` to `to`; Svelte: `moveItem`). Focus stays on the pressed button, or moves to its partner when that one is disabled at an end of the list. Say what happened with `announce()` (README). An item shows its `label` and `description` (richer content: the Svelte component's `item` snippet).

### Svelte: Props

Generisch über `T`.

| Prop | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `items` (Pflicht) | `readonly T[]` |  | The items in their current order. The list does not reorder them itself: `onmove` and `onremove` tell you what the user asked for. |
| `key` | `((item: T, index: number) => ItemKey)` |  | Identifies an item while it moves (keyed rendering). Default: `item.id`, else the index. |
| `itemLabel` | `((item: T, index: number) => string)` |  | Name of an item, used in the accessible names of its buttons. Default: `item.label`, or the item itself when it is a string or number. |
| `label` | `string` | Katalog `sortableList.label` | Accessible name of the list. |
| `upText` | `string` | Katalog `sortableList.upText` | Visible texts of the buttons (default: the catalogue). |
| `downText` | `string` | Katalog `sortableList.downText` |  |
| `removeText` | `string` | Katalog `sortableList.removeText` |  |
| `upLabel` | `string` | Katalog `sortableList.upLabel` | Accessible names of the buttons; `{name}` is replaced by the item's name. They should contain the visible text. |
| `downLabel` | `string` | Katalog `sortableList.downLabel` |  |
| `removeLabel` | `string` | Katalog `sortableList.removeLabel` |  |
| `removable` | `boolean` | `true` | Show the remove button. Default true. |
| `dragDrop` | `boolean` | `true` | Items can also be moved by dragging with the mouse (an extra: the buttons are the way for keyboard and touch). Default true. |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `class` | `string` | `''` |  |

## StatusMessage

Svelte: `import { StatusMessage } from '@mozra-the-great/kern'` · Element: `<k-status-message>` aus `@mozra-the-great/kern/elements/status-message`

Quelle: [`StatusMessage.svelte`](../../src/lib/components/StatusMessage.svelte), [`KStatusMessage.svelte`](../../src/elements/KStatusMessage.svelte)

Visible live region for the result of an action: put the element on the page empty and set `message` later (a region that arrives with its text is not announced by every screen reader). `kind="status"` is polite, `kind="alert"` assertive (errors). One line of height is kept while it is empty; `reserve="false"` turns that off.

### Svelte: Props

| Prop | Typ | Vorgabe | Beschreibung |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `message` | `string \| null` |  | The text; empty until there is something to say. Render the component from the start and change only this: a live region that appears together with its text is not announced by every screen reader. |
| `kind` | `'status' \| 'alert'` | `'status'` | `status` (polite, `role="status"`) for results; `alert` (assertive, `role="alert"`) for errors. |
| `reserve` | `boolean` | `true` | Keep one line of height while empty, so the layout does not jump when the text arrives. |
| `class` | geerbt | `''` |  |
